newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh bourses closed for opposition strike.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh bourses closed for opposition strike.

text.p: An opposition-led strike on Sunday shut Bangladesh's main Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) and the Chittagong Stock Exchange.
The country-wide eight-hour strike, called by the opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), halted traffic and closed down banks and businesses.
"The trading on the floor could not take place due to absence of brokers," said one DSE official.
The DSE all-share price index fell 33.81 points or 2.65 percent down at 1,240.04 at the close of Saturday's trading. Friday is weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
